basic_info.description: Live steps from the best of Cow Hollow. This updated, light-filled flat blends vintage charm with modern design  and it's just a short walk to Union & Chestnut Street shops, restaurants, gyms, and transit. Inside, you'll find soaring coved ceilings, bay windows, and hardwood floors throughout. The open layout flows from the spacious living area to a chef's kitchen with quartz countertops, Viking appliances, wine fridge, and bar seating  perfect for entertaining or unwinding. Enjoy city living with thoughtful touches like custom closets, a mudroom/home office nook, and access to a shared roof deck with jaw-dropping Golden Gate views. Two bright bedrooms, 1 stylish bath. Open floor plan with hardwood floors throughout. Spacious living area with bay windows overlooking Union Street. Renovated kitchen with custom cabinetry, quartz counters, Viking appliances & new disposal. Modern bathroom with designer tile & vanity. In-unit full size stackable Maytag washer/dryer. High ceilings with vintage molding details. Shared rooftop deck with panoramic Bay & Bridge views. Storage nook, could double as an office, with built-in shelving. Newer double-paned windows. Built-out closets. Upgraded electrical. Seismic reinforcement completed.
